title: Reflective invocation via Type.forName (apex) — review required
description: The apex call Type.forName selects a class, method, or module at runtime by name. If the name comes from untrusted input, the caller chooses which code runs. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms the name is fixed or replaces it with a fixed allowlist of class names.
remediation: Resolve names only from a fixed allow-list, or replace with a fixed allowlist of class names.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any Type.forName call matches whether or not the name is user-controlled. Regex cannot prove data flow; a constant name is a false positive.
